breach.summary: Personal, medical, and health insurance data of over 22.6M people stolen. Exposed data includes SSNs, DOB, driver's license numbers, and health insurance details.
ShinyHunters leaked 2.4GB of data from blockchain lender after employee social engineering. Exposed names, DOB, email, addresses, and phone numbers.
ShinyHunters confirmed breach of Vimeo user and customer data. Group actively threatening to leak stolen files unless Vimeo pays ransom.
Listed by Everest ransomware group. Compromised data includes SSNs, Tax IDs, W-2/1099 forms, mortgage records, and health savings account data.
CVE-2024-4577 exploited for mass data exfiltration. Clop ransomware gang stole financial records, healthcare data, and government documents across multiple organizations.
Unauthorized access to customer personal information including names, dates of birth, email addresses, phone numbers, and SSNs through API vulnerability.
LockBit ransomware attack on UnitedHealth subsidiary. Massive healthcare data breach affecting insurers, providers, and patients nationwide.
Nearly all US adults exposed. Data includes full names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, and partial SSNs sold on dark web.
Healthcare provider exposed member names, member IDs, policy numbers, dates of birth, and health information through unsecured database.
Law enforcement agencies' access credentials compromised. Unauthorized access to facial recognition database containing billions of images scraped from web.

cve.summary: Authentication bypass actively exploited. Unauthenticated remote attackers gain full control panel access.
RCE via git push injection. Any authenticated user could execute arbitrary commands on backend servers.
Improper access control zero-day exploited in the wild. Unauthenticated RCE via crafted requests.
Unauthenticated RCE via crafted IKE v2 packets. Double free vulnerability.
Zero-click NTLM hash leak. APT28 actively exploiting against Ukraine and EU targets.
Authentication bypass in web UI. Allows unauthenticated remote code execution on network devices.
Pre-auth RCE in CI/CD pipeline. Widely exploited to deploy ransomware and steal source code.
Path traversal + RCE in secure mobile access appliance. Exploited in active campaigns.
Deserialization RCE in e-commerce platform. Public exploits available, widespread attacks detected.
Privilege escalation in netfilter subsystem. Allows local unprivileged user to escalate to root.

threat.ttp: Zero-click exploits, PRISMEX malware, LNK chains
threat.summary: Actively exploiting CVE-2026-32202 in attacks against Ukraine and EU. Using AI-generated PRISMEX backdoor for persistent access.

threat.ttp: ClickFix initial access, Slopoly backdoor, Interlock encryption
threat.summary: Using AI-generated Slopoly malware. Victims include Texas Tech, DaVita, Kettering Health. Demanding 8-figure ransoms.

threat.ttp: Social engineering, MFA bypass, Alphv/BlackCat ransomware
threat.summary: One of most prolific ransomware groups. Uses social engineering to bypass MFA. Targets high-value organizations for maximum payouts.

threat.ttp: Supply chain attacks, Trojanized software, blockchain theft
threat.summary: Responsible for $100M+ cryptocurrency thefts. Using trojanized developer tools to target exchanges and DeFi platforms.

threat.ttp: Spear phishing, malware delivery, lateral movement
threat.summary: Longest-running financially motivated group. Targets payment systems and customer databases. Estimated $1B+ in theft.
Chinese-linked APT blending cybercrime and espionage. Using zero-days and supply chain attacks for long-term persistence.
Largest ransomware group by revenue. Operating as RaaS with global affiliate network. Billions in ransom collected.

threat.ttp: Zero-day exploitation, mass extortion, data theft
threat.summary: Exploiting CVE-2024-4577 in MOVEit for mass campaigns. Stolen data from healthcare, finance, and government sectors.
Successor to DarkSide. Responsible for Colonial Pipeline attack impact. Using double extortion and DDoS threats.

threat.ttp: Malware delivery, banking trojans, lateral movement
threat.summary: Operators of TrickBot banking malware. Targeting financial institutions for account takeover and fraud schemes.

news.title: CISA adds 8 exploited flaws to KEV — Cisco, JetBrains, SonicWall deadlines set
news.summary: CISA added 8 actively exploited CVEs including Cisco IOS XE, JetBrains TeamCity, and SonicWall SMA flaws. FCEB federal agency deadlines set.

news.title: FBI warns of sharp rise in AI-enabled cargo theft targeting logistics sector
news.summary: FBI issued warning to transportation and logistics industry of sharp rise in cyber-enabled cargo theft with losses surging. AI tools being used to improve targeting and routes.

news.title: Ransomware negotiator sentenced: 4 years for insider attacks on own clients
news.summary: Two former incident response firm employees sentenced for running BlackCat ransomware attacks against their own clients while posing as negotiators for ransom collection.

news.title: CrowdStrike April 2026 Patch Tuesday: 164 CVEs, double March's volume
news.summary: CrowdStrike analysis of April Patch Tuesday reveals 164 Microsoft CVEs — double March's count. Critical flaws in IKE, TCP/IP, and RDP.

news.title: CISA Director warns of nation-state attacks targeting US critical infrastructure
news.summary: CISA Director Jen Easterly testifies to Congress on escalating nation-state cyber attacks against US energy, water, and transportation infrastructure by Russia and China.

news.title: National Cyber Strategy 2.0 emphasizes zero trust and quantum readiness
news.summary: White House releases updated National Cyber Strategy focusing on zero trust architecture, post-quantum cryptography, and increased public-private sector collaboration.

news.title: Log4Shell still being actively exploited — unpatched systems under attack
news.summary: Nearly 4 years after disclosure, Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) remains one of the most exploited vulnerabilities. Millions of unpatched systems still under active attack worldwide.

news.title: SEC announces new cybersecurity disclosure rules for public companies
news.summary: SEC finalizes rules requiring public companies to disclose material cybersecurity incidents within 4 days. Stock exchanges must report breaches affecting trading.

news.title: Cyber insurance premiums spike 40% as claims soar — market faces uncertainty
news.summary: Cyber insurance premiums increased 40% YoY as ransomware claims continue climbing. Some insurers exiting market due to unsustainable loss ratios.

news.title: AI-powered phishing emails bypassing traditional email security at 3x rate
news.summary: Report shows AI-generated phishing emails 3x more likely to bypass traditional email filters. Spear phishing success rates rising as attacks become more personalized and convincing.
